verdict.rationale: Ardent documents a per-PR CI workflow ('Every PR runs against its own fresh database branch'). It also offers CI-friendly CLI branch creation (`ardent branch create pr-123 --print-url`), token-based auth with no login step, idempotent re-runs, JSON errors, and an API aimed at CI systems. Branch deletion appears only in the agent workflow, where the CLI handles 'creating, using, and deleting' branches. Automated teardown on PR close from CI is never documented, and no deploy-platform integration is shown. missing for 10: documented automatic per-PR teardown on PR close/merge in CI, native deploy-platform (e.g. preview-deployment) integration, a concrete CI pipeline example, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can create and tear down per-pull-request database branches automatically from CI or my deploy platform

citations.quote: Every PR runs against its own fresh database branch cloned from your connected source
Set ARDENT_TOKEN and run commands normally — no login step
Use the API when you are building CI systems, internal developer platforms, custom dashboards, or agent workflows.
The agent runs the Ardent CLI itself — creating, using, and deleting its own branches
a re-run picks up the original request instead of starting a second one
